# Copilot instructions for nAIlbook

nAIlbook is a manicure booking platform: a React client (`client/`) and an Express REST API (`server/`). Copilot is used for the client.

## Source of truth

Read these before changing anything in `client/`:

- [.claude/skills/ui-conventions/SKILL.md](../.claude/skills/ui-conventions/SKILL.md): structure, screens and UI rules
- [.claude/skills/best-code-practices/SKILL.md](../.claude/skills/best-code-practices/SKILL.md): the React practices of the client (folders, effects in hooks, aborting requests, controlled forms, the carousel) with their reasons
- [.claude/skills/ui-design/SKILL.md](../.claude/skills/ui-design/SKILL.md): colour and font tokens, spacing, components, states, motion and UI wording. Read it before you build or restyle a screen.
- [docs/architecture.md](../docs/architecture.md): modules and how they connect

The UI sections below mirror `ui-conventions`, and *Code practices* mirrors `best-code-practices`. If they disagree, the skill wins. When the skill changes, this file is updated in the same change.

## Structure

```
client/src/
  api/          typed fetch wrapper (client.ts) + one file per resource (auth, manicurists, bookings, me)
  contexts/     one pair per context: <Name>Context.ts (createContext and its type) + <Name>Provider.tsx (the state)
  hooks/        one hook per file (useAuth, useForm, useFrom, useAsync, useReducedMotion, useScrollToHash, useBookingParams, useBookSlot, useMyBookingsWeek, useCancelBooking, ...)
  components/   one folder per component, in kebab-case: <kebab-name>/<Name>.tsx + <Name>.module.css
    guards/     route guards as layout routes that render <Outlet /> (GuestGuard, RoleGuard)
  pages/        one folder per screen or group of screens: <page>/<Name>.tsx + <Name>.module.css
  utils/        plain helpers with no React, one file per topic (format.ts: formatPrice, formatDuration, formatTime, formatTimeRange, formatLongDate, formatDateRange, formatCancelledBy, formatWeekBookingCount, initials; dates.ts: Sofia YYYY-MM-DD dates, todayInSofia, sofiaDateOfIso, addDays, addMonths, lastBookableDate, startOfWeek, weekOfIso, weekdayOf, minutesInSofia)
```

- **Every component and page has its own `.module.css`.** Screens that share a layout share one module: `pages/auth/Auth.module.css` serves `Login.tsx` and `Register.tsx`. How the styles are written (Tailwind `@apply` with the tokens) is in `ui-design`.
- **Logic goes into hooks.** State or logic that more than one component could use lives in a hook in `hooks/`, not in the component. Components read a context through its hook (`useAuth()`), never with `use(AuthContext)` directly. A hook is added when the first screen needs it, not in advance.
- **Shared components:** `layout/Layout` (every page on the night: `Backdrop`, `Header`, `main` in the 1280px column (`ui-design`, *Layout and spacing*) with `<Outlet />`, and `Footer`), `backdrop/Backdrop` (all the decoration: glitter, aurora, milky way, flourishes, rays, stars; `aria-hidden`; the flourishes fainter below `lg`, the flourishes and the stars hidden below `sm`), `header/Header` (a client also sees the link «Моите часове» to `/my-bookings` before their name, a `NavLink`, so it has `aria-current="page"` there), `logo/Logo` (the n[AI]lbook link to `/`, named «nAIlbook — начало», in the header and the footer), `footer/Footer`, `sheet/Sheet` (the light surface of a working screen: every screen except `/` puts its content, its loading and error states included, in one; the auth forms in a `narrow` one), `search-form/SearchForm` (the glass search panel; below `lg` «Търсене» takes its own line, the full width), `manicurist-card/ManicuristCard`, `manicurist-carousel/ManicuristCarousel` (the search results in Swiper, `best-code-practices` §10), `search-results/SearchResults` (the carousel and the map of one search with the active card, keyed by the search), `studio-map/StudioMap` (a Leaflet map with a marker per studio, `best-code-practices` §11), `button/Button`, `form-field/FormField`, `error-message/ErrorMessage`, `loader/Loader`, `price/Price`, `week-schedule/WeekSchedule` (the weekly timetable of free times and «Заето» blocks, a real `<table>`), `booking-week/BookingWeek` (a client's upcoming bookings as a week board, Monday to Sunday, each booking a `<button aria-pressed>`), `booking-details/BookingDetails` (the active booking with its studio, its status and the cancel form), `booking-list/BookingList` (bookings as read-only rows), `status-badge/StatusBadge` (the «Отменен» pill), `guards/GuestGuard` and `guards/RoleGuard`. Later screens add others the same way.
- **Routes** are in `App.tsx`: `AuthProvider` around `Routes`, every screen nested under the `Layout` route, guest-only screens under `GuestGuard`, the screens of a role under `<RoleGuard roles={[...]} />` (`/my-bookings` under `roles={['CLIENT']}`; the manicurist screens reuse it). While `/me` loads, `RoleGuard` shows the `Loader` on a `Sheet`; a guest goes to `/login` with `state: { from: <pathname + search> }`, so login brings them back to the same page and week; a user with another role goes to `/`.

**API wrapper:**
- reads `VITE_API_URL`;
- attaches `Authorization: Bearer <token>`;
- takes an optional `signal` (an `AbortSignal`) and passes it to `fetch`; an aborted request rethrows the browser's `AbortError` as it is, never as `NETWORK_ERROR`;
- on an error, parses `{ error: { code, message, details } }` and throws an `ApiError` with those fields and the HTTP status;
- when the request does not reach the server at all, throws an `ApiError` with the client-only code `NETWORK_ERROR` and the message «Няма връзка със сървъра. Проверете връзката и опитайте отново.»;
- when an error response has no `{ error }` body, throws an `ApiError` with `INTERNAL_ERROR` and `UNEXPECTED_ERROR_MESSAGE`, «Нещо се обърка. Опитайте отново.» A form shows the same text when its submit throws anything other than an `ApiError`.

Components call the wrapper in `client/src/api/`, never a raw `fetch`.

**Loading data:** a screen loads its data with `useAsync(fn, deps)` from `hooks/`. Every run gets its own `AbortController`: `fn` receives the `signal` and passes it to the API function, and the effect's cleanup aborts the run, so an old answer never replaces a newer one (a new search, leaving the screen). It returns `{ data, error, loading }`: `error` is the message to show (the `ApiError` message, else `UNEXPECTED_ERROR_MESSAGE`), and `data` keeps the previous result while a new run loads. Submits are not aborted, because an aborted POST may still be saved on the server. The reasons and the patterns are in `best-code-practices`.

**Auth state:**
- Only the token is kept in `localStorage`, under the key `nailbook.token`. The user always comes from the server: from `GET /api/auth/me` at startup, and from the `{ token, user }` response after login or registration.
- At startup, while `/me` is pending, `loading` is true (the call passes a `signal` and is aborted in the effect's cleanup, like every load): the header shows «Зареждане…» instead of the guest menu, and `GuestGuard` shows the `Loader`. A 401 clears the token. Any other error leaves the user a guest and keeps the token for the next load.
- A `401 UNAUTHORIZED` on a request sent with a token logs the user out. `401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS` on login is sent without a token and only shows its message.
- Logout first calls `POST /api/auth/logout`, which revokes the token on the server, and then clears `localStorage`. Clear it even when the call fails. Then go to `/`. While the call runs, «Изход» is disabled and says «Излизане…».
- **Back to where the user came from.** A screen that sends a guest to login passes `state: { from: <path> }`. `useFrom()` reads it, with `/` as the default. After login or registration the user goes there; the links between `/login` and `/register` pass `state: { from }` on. `GuestGuard` sends a logged-in user to the same place, so a user who opens `/login` while logged in lands on `/`.

## UI rules

- **The client never decides a slot is free.** It shows only what `/slots` returns and never computes a free time from `busy`: only the starts in `slots` are buttons. On `409 SLOT_TAKEN`, `409 DAY_OFF` or `400 SLOT_INVALID` from `POST /api/bookings`, show the message and reload the slots.
- **The week table:** only the times `/slots` returned for a date are buttons, and only the `busy` intervals are «Заето». Days without working hours get no column; a day off (`dayOff` from `/slots`) is «Почивен ден»; dates before today and after the 12-month limit are «—» and are never requested. Today, the weeks and the row of every free time and «Заето» block are computed in Sofia (`utils/dates.ts`, `minutesInSofia`; `formatTime` in `utils/format.ts`), never from the browser's time zone.
- **Text:** all UI text is in Bulgarian. Code identifiers and comments stay in English.
- **Dates and times:** format with `Intl.DateTimeFormat('bg-BG', { timeZone: 'Europe/Sofia' })`, and send dates to the API as `YYYY-MM-DD`.
- **Prices:** always with cents: `25,00 €`, `35,50 €`. `formatPrice` in `utils/format.ts` gives the text; the `Price` component shows it with the cents smaller (`ui-design`, *Components*, Price).
- **Durations:** show durations as `60 мин` (`formatDuration` in `utils/format.ts`).
- **An empty phone is never shown.** `phone` is optional and comes as `""` when there is none (in `user`, `booking` and `manicurist`). The schedule, the manicurist's page and every other place that shows a phone leave out the whole phone line, label included, when it is empty.
- **Errors:** show the server's `message`. Show field errors from `VALIDATION_ERROR` next to their inputs: `details[].path` is the field name (`"city"`). A detail whose path has no visible field goes into the error box: `useForm`'s `submitHandler(onSubmit, visibleFields)` takes the fields shown right now (default: every field in `values`). A radio group is a visible field, so its error goes under the fieldset, linked with `aria-describedby`. Forms have `noValidate` and send every visible field as a string, even an empty one, so the errors come from the server.
- **Responsive layout:** design mobile-first with Tailwind. Every screen must work at 375px width.
- **Accessibility basics:**
  - every input has a label, buttons are real `<button>` elements, and disabled dates and slots are actually `disabled`;
  - every flow works with the keyboard alone, and focus is visible (`focus-visible:` ring classes, never `outline-none` without a replacement);
  - a button with only an icon has an `aria-label` in Bulgarian, and the icon has `aria-hidden="true"`;
  - text has a contrast of at least 4.5:1 against its background.

## Code practices

Mirrors `best-code-practices`, which has the reasons and the code patterns.

- **Folders by kind of code:** `api/` talks to the server, `hooks/` holds state and effects, `contexts/` shared state, `components/` reusable parts, `pages/` screens, `utils/` plain functions with no React.
- **Components:** one folder per component with its own CSS Module; only module classes in the JSX; a widget's own classes are styled through `:global(...)` under a module class. Props have a named type; data types come from `api/`.
- **Effects only for syncing** with something outside React (a request, a listener, a timer, a widget). Derived data is computed in render. Every effect cleans up. Dependencies are honest (no `eslint-disable`); a callback that must not restart the effect is read through `useEffectEvent`. A form starts again with new values through a `key`, not an effect.
- **An effect with a name of its own goes into a hook** (`useAsync`, a listener, a widget's setup).
- **Loading data:** `useAsync(fn, deps)` gives each run an `AbortController` and aborts it in the cleanup; the `signal` goes down to `request()` and `fetch`, an API function that loads data takes `signal` last, and an aborted request is never shown as an error. The previous data stays while a new run loads. Submits are not aborted; `pending` guards them.
- **Controlled forms** through `useForm`: `name`, `value`, `onChange={changeHandler}`; `submitHandler` calls `preventDefault()`; `noValidate`, the server validates. An inline form that replaces its opening button (the cancel form) focuses its field on open (`autoFocus`), «Назад» closes it in `flushSync` and focuses the button again, and a success moves the focus to the panel heading (`tabIndex={-1}`).
- **Contexts:** a `<Name>Context.ts` + `<Name>Provider.tsx` pair, read only through its hook, only for state many parts need.
- **The URL as state:** a search, filter or page lives in the URL (`useSearchParams`), not copied into `useState`.
- **Names:** `<action>Handler` passed as `on<Action>`; PascalCase components, kebab-case folders, `useXxx` hooks.
- **Lists and cards:** `key` is the server id. A card that opens a page uses a stretched link (the heading link's `::after` covers the card), never an `<a>` around the card. A card that selects instead (the manicurist card on `/`) uses a stretched `<button aria-pressed>` with the name the same way, styled as the heading text; a click on the active card keeps it active. Hover and keyboard focus (`.card:has(:focus-visible)`, not `:focus-within`) give the ring and the lift; after a mouse click only the active look stays. A second link on the card («Запази час») sits above it with `relative z-10` and its own accessible name, «Запази час при <име>», and is the only way to the manicurist's page. Hover and focus on the card call `onHighlight(id)`, leaving calls `onHighlight(null)`.
- **Carousel (Swiper):** own `<button>` arrows with Bulgarian `aria-label`s through refs; the `A11y` and `Keyboard` modules; no `loop`, `rewind` is allowed (the arrows go round with no copies, never disabled); `breakpoints` for 1, 2 and 3 slides; padding inside so the lift is not cut; equal slide heights (`height: auto`); a `role="status"` counter «Показани 1–3 от 6» (or «Показана 1 от 6») from the first card in view, `min(activeIndex, n − perView)`; `aria-hidden` dots; `speed: 0` under reduced motion; a `key` from the search on `SearchResults` (carousel, map and `activeId` together) so a new search starts at the first card; loading, error and empty states before it. `activeId` is owned by `SearchResults`: a card click or a marker sets it; the user moving the carousel makes the first card in view active (`onSlideChange`); one effect brings the active card into view only when it is not (`slideTo(index)` before the view, `slideTo(index − perView + 1)` after it), and a ref flag around the carousel's own `slideTo` (and between `onBeforeResize` and `onResize`) keeps it from changing `activeId` (Swiper 14 emits `slideChange` inside `slideTo` even with `runCallbacks: false`). The counter and dots follow the view; the instance stays in a ref.
- **Imperative widgets (Leaflet):** created once in an effect on a ref and destroyed in the cleanup, updated in separate effects, driven through props and callbacks; the same information is available outside the widget. `StudioMap` (plain `leaflet`, never `react-leaflet`): props `markers` (a stable array; a parent whose data reloads keeps it by content, `useMemo(() => JSON.parse(key), [key])` with `key = JSON.stringify(markers)`, so a reload keeps the map's view), `activeId`, `highlightedId`, `onMarkerSelect?`, `label` (on the container, which is `role="region"`); it fills a frame `<div>` in the parent that sets its size, border and radius; four effects (create, draw markers, mark active and highlighted, fly to the active marker); `L.divIcon` markers (never the default images), a selectable one with `role="button"`, `aria-label="<име> на картата"`, `aria-pressed`, Enter and Space; without `onMarkerSelect` `role="img"`; `fitBounds` with padding and `maxZoom: 15` (`setView` zoom 16 for one marker), a `zoomRequest` counter from `SearchResults`, bumped on every choice of the user, flies the map to the active marker at zoom 16 (`flyTo`; `setView` under reduced motion); a `L.Control` «Всички студиа» on top of the zoom buttons calls `fitBounds` again; the controls are frosted glass (white 65%, backdrop blur) and the container's ground is `map-ground`, never Leaflet's grey; the wheel zooms only with Ctrl (⌘): a capture-phase `wheel` listener stops other turns before Leaflet (the page scrolls) and shows the hint «Задръжте Ctrl и завъртете колелото, за да приближите картата.» for 1.5 s; `dragging: false` on `(pointer: coarse)`; the flight to a chosen studio goes in steps of at most 5 zoom levels and waits for each step's tiles (`updateWhenZooming: false`), so no empty ground shows; zoom titles «Приближи» and «Отдалечи»; tiles `https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png` with the visible attribution «© сътрудниците на OpenStreetMap» linked to `/copyright` and no Leaflet prefix (`setPrefix(false)`); no animation under reduced motion; `isolation: isolate` on the container.

## Project rules

- **Stack:** React, TypeScript, Vite, React Router, Tailwind (applied with `@apply` in each component's CSS Module, see `ui-design`). Ask before adding any other dependency.
- **Do not change `server/`** from Copilot sessions.
- **No secrets** in code or committed files. Use `.env`, which is gitignored.
